cases.scenario: 12 parametrized malformed-locator variants (null required fields, +/float non-decimal, byte_range end<=start, line_range zero/reversed bounds, json_pointer bad tilde digit, missing locator_text key, whole_source all-non-null)
cases.expected: validate_locator raises LocatorError with the documented error code for each variant

cases.scenario: JSON_POINTER locator_text exceeding 1024 UTF-8 bytes via multi-byte (λ) characters, where char-length alone would not cross the boundary
cases.expected: rejected with locator.pointer_too_long (byte length enforced, not char length)

cases.scenario: JSON_POINTER descending through a scalar value (/a/b where a is a scalar)
cases.expected: extract_excerpt raises locator.pointer_not_found

cases.scenario: JSON_POINTER locator_text explicitly null passed straight to extract_excerpt
cases.expected: locator.field_required

cases.scenario: BYTE_RANGE end-exclusive exactness: body ABCDE, start=1 end=3
cases.expected: excerpt == 'BC' and the excluded end-index byte ('D') is absent from the result

cases.scenario: LINE_RANGE inclusive exactness: 3-line body, start=1 end=2 (1-based)
cases.expected: excerpt == 'L0\nL1' and line 3 (end+1) is absent

cases.scenario: JSON_POINTER nested resolution combining ~1 (escaped '/'), ~0 (escaped '~'), and an array index in one pointer path
cases.expected: resolves to the exact nested leaf value

cases.scenario: correct() with a wrong expected_active_revision_id
cases.expected: raises correction_conflict AND leaves command/canonical_artifact/key_state/event_log row counts unchanged (zero new state on conflict)

cases.scenario: Atomicity of correct(): inspect accepted_changeset + state_delta rows directly for the returned changeset_id
cases.expected: exactly one accepted_changeset row and exactly two state_delta rows ({RETRACT, ADD}) share the single changeset_id -- RETRACT+ADD land as one atomic changeset

cases.scenario: Decrypt both the corrected envelope and the original (prior) envelope after correct()
cases.expected: corrected blob decrypts to 'corrected body'; prior blob is untouched and still decrypts to 'original body'

cases.scenario: Same source body sealed via all four locator kinds (BYTE_RANGE, LINE_RANGE, JSON_POINTER, WHOLE_SOURCE)
cases.expected: all four fragment_semantic_digest values and all four locator_digest values are pairwise distinct

cases.scenario: For BYTE_RANGE, LINE_RANGE, and WHOLE_SOURCE fragments, scan the raw stored CAS blob bytes for the plaintext excerpt text and for the field names 'excerpt'/'body'/'locator_text'
cases.expected: the plaintext excerpt and those field names are absent from the stored ciphertext blob -- encrypted-before-durability holds, no plaintext leak

cases.scenario: add_evidence_edge with 7 invalid support_kind variants (lowercase, empty, near-miss spellings, trailing space)
cases.expected: every variant raises invalid_support_kind

cases.scenario: Identical assertion/fragment/locator digests, only support_kind differs (SUPPORTS vs CONTRADICTS)
cases.expected: edge_semantic_digest differs between the two

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent with no deletion_state row at all for prior_object_id
cases.expected: new_consent_prior_deletion_incomplete; zero new command/canonical_artifact/key_state/event_log rows

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent with a deletion_state row whose phase_state is PENDING (not COMPLETE)
cases.expected: new_consent_prior_deletion_incomplete; zero new rows

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent missing platform_absence_receipt, missing recovery_absence_receipt, and missing both (3 sub-cases)
cases.expected: new_consent_missing_absence_receipts in every sub-case; zero new rows

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent with consent_epoch not strictly greater than prior_consent_epoch (equal 2==2, and reversed 3>2, 5>1)
cases.expected: new_consent_epoch_not_greater in every sub-case; zero new rows

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent with empty raw_body
cases.expected: new_consent_body_required; zero new rows

cases.scenario: remember_new_consent happy path: seeded COMPLETE deletion_state + both absence receipts + strictly greater epoch + fresh non-empty body
cases.expected: creates exactly +1 command, +1 canonical_artifact, +1 key_state row, with a fresh artifact_semantic_digest/logical_object_id distinct from the prior object

cases.scenario: Wrap pipeline.cas in a call-recording spy and exercise both a failing precondition path and the happy path of remember_new_consent
cases.expected: the prior object's blob_id never appears in cas.get() call history in either path -- new-consent never reads/unwraps prior ciphertext

cases.scenario: tombstone_object() on a REMEMBERed object, then independently call project_expected_active() on the returned changeset_id
cases.expected: the single matching projection row for object_id has expected_active_revision_id == null (no active revision)
